title: Basic Toaster Oven, no bells and whistles
text: Basic Toaster Oven, no bells and whistles. This is a regular toaster oven, reasonably priced which does the job well (despite some of the negative feedbacks on here). I had no problem using this for evenly toasting and having consistent heating. The toast came out perfect. I also used this for baking some items (i.e. frozen pizza and some cinnamon buns) and I had no issues. I think this oven is a little cheaply made, and I have fears that over time the door may loosen and unhinge, but I guess you get what you pay for. It's stylish looking and compact, fits well on my countertop. Only 4 stars as it is basic and does the job. For $10-20 more you could do better in a Cuisinart model.

product_metadata.title: Oster Toaster Oven, 4 Slice, Stainless Steel (TSSTTVVGS1)
features: Small 4-slice toaster oven with stylish brushed stainless steel housing
Dual dial controls to toast, bake, and broil
Wide temperature range of 150 to 450 degrees F and 30-minute timer with toast shade settings
2 rack positions to accommodate a wide variety of foods from tall roasts to pizza
Includes removable crumb tray and durable baking pan
description: With its sleek stainless steel finish, chrome-plated accents, and energy-efficient operation, the Oster 4-Slice Toaster Oven offers more than just good looks. This small toaster oven provides a spacious interior that can accommodate up to four slices of bread at a time and can be used to bake a veggie casserole, broil fish, and much more. Two manual control dials ensure simple and precise operation. The first dial lets you set the baking temperature to up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit or position it to Toast mode for toasting or Broil mode for broiling. The second dial allows you to set the timer for up to 30 minutes and choose the toast shade setting from light to dark. It can also be turned to the stay-on position for continuous cooking. The included adjustable rack can be placed in two positions, allowing you to customize the space. A see-through door lets you check on your food at a glance, while a stay-cool door handle makes opening and closing the door safe. This toaster oven comes with a removable, easy-clean crumb tray and a durable baking pan. Efficient in both design and performance, this bread toaster and oven makes a useful addition to any busy kitchen.
